limitations: This artifact records source and read-only semantic review; runtime results must be recorded separately.
FK arithmetic is numerically equivalent, not bit-identical; current integration comparison uses boxes atol 3e-6 with rtol 0 while keeping joints/pose/errors/attempts/valid/RNG strict.
Unperformed collision checks for IK-invalid attempts are intentionally reported as None instead of prior true/false diagnostics.
SAT guard is conservative for current finite meter-scale assets and unit rotations; it is not a formal all-input IEEE-754 equivalence proof.
Fixed geometry/device is an internal cache invariant. Inference-tensor self-pair masks must not be mutated after cache creation without invalidation.
Changes to docs/plan/PLAN18.md and documentation submodule belong outside this Python contract audit and were preserved.

cpu_hull_reference_comparison.note: OBB tensors precomputed once outside timing; same actual batch, full valid decisions compared.

intermediate_old_collision_profile.note: Obstacle placement had already loaded the new GPU path during startup. This is not an entirely unmodified baseline. Third iteration was profiled.

failed_cpu_only_face_attempt.reason: Collection exceeded 10s as reset activity grew; not accepted.

later_cpu_face_profile.note: Before final GPU face proof and accepted FK reuse.

limitations: No claim about other hardware or all seeds.
32 training iterations assess throughput, not learned behavior success.
Initial simulator creation and initial reset are outside the RSL collection timer.
General Stabilize shares the reset code but its stabilization reward behavior and 2048 training performance were not evaluated here.
The exact LP remains a fallback; fixtures with zero LP calls do not prove zero LP calls for all possible layouts.
FK boxes are compared at 3e-6 absolute tolerance for FP32 kernel trig/reduction and batch/stride differences; measured maximum is in gpu_integration. Bit-exact full-layout equivalence is not claimed.
IK-invalid rows skip collision checking and report collision_free=null. Their acceptance remains false.
SAT ambiguity guard is validated for current meter-scale fixed assets, not arbitrary ill-conditioned geometry.
